title: Love it
body:
It’s such a nice app and has so many tools but now most of the tools aren’t for free and you have to pay money to use it, in the past it was free tho so it’s really disappointing. 
Also, it used to have options for tasks that I can choose what to add for my to do list but now there are no options and I have to write it myself.
Another thing, the alarm doesn’t work, I was shocked to wake up 2 hours after I was supposed to because the alarm didn’t work. It only buzz a bit but with no sound. 
The emojis of the tasks are ugly and very disappointing.
And in the water tracker there’s no option for changing it from “oz” to “litres” and its super hard to understand it like that.
